title: fix(platform-objects): Parent Organization and Sort Order say they matter only with several organizations
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DPskZrGJsWDXJjZgotFY1fd)_

Fixes #30210

Card thread `session_016WV4czYDK9GofBYXSyFkwJ` for `domain:server#4` (claim 6670535485, amended 6670640620). Executes ruling 6670372892: row 4 C here, row 3 D (`sys_organization.timezone` left as it is) closes with this PR, row 4 A is a separate card the seat files.

## 维护者速读

- 问题:单组织部署里「编辑组织」页照样显示「上级组织」「排序」,管理员看不出它们在这里没有作用。
- 本 PR:这两个字段的帮助文字末尾加一句「仅在部署运行多个组织时有意义」,英文同步。
- 不变:字段仍然显示、可编辑;权限、数据、行为都不变。时区字段按第 3 行 D 原样保留。
- 隐藏这两个字段(第 4 行 A,字段组 `requiresFeature`)另立卡,不在本 PR。
- 风险:纯文案,无迁移;es-ES / ja-JP 包没改(裁定只点名 en / zh-CN),它们继续显示旧句。
- 规模:5 个文件,+52 / -6。

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts`: the `parent_organization_id` and `sort_order` descriptions end with "Meaningful only where the deployment runs several organizations." (the wording the object's `create_organization` action already uses: "Available only where the deployment runs several organizations."). The code comments around them (L39, L482) do not restate the description, so they stay.
- `en.objects.generated.ts`: the same two helps; `pnpm i18n:extract` reproduces it byte for byte (no change after the run).
- `zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`: the two helps end with 「仅在部署运行多个组织时有意义。」.
- New pin `sys-organization-multi-org-fields-help.test.ts` (beside `sys-organization-name-timezone-help.test.ts`): the declaration says it, the en pack equals the declaration, the zh-CN pack says it.
- One changeset, `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

## Why

From #30210 row 4: an administrator on a single-organization deployment sees 上级组织 / 排序 on Edit organization and expects an effect. Ruling 6670372892 chose C: say so in the help, no hiding.

## Verification

- Red on `main` `b77c160a` (declaration + packs from main, new test kept): 4 failed / 2 passed (the declaration and zh-CN cases red; the en-equals-declaration case passes on both sides by construction). Green on `35c17506`: 6/6.
- `@objectstack/platform-objects` test: 116 files, 1577 tests passed; typecheck exit 0 (both on `35c17506`).
- `pnpm i18n:extract`: exit 0, no change. `check:i18n` exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 58 families on `35c17506`; all 58 exit 0; `--ran`: 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 on prerequisites; re-run after fetching the pinned fixture commit and the build closure, both exit 0.)
- `83a9b2fd` merges `origin/main` `a2437b56`; the four commits it brings touch no `platform-objects` file. `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- es-ES and ja-JP packs carry their own translations of the two helps (no source-hash entry, so they are legacy-trusted and served as written): they keep the old sentence without the new clause. The ruling names en / zh-CN only, and no bundle check required more, so they are left; a translator pass can add the clause.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` runs in CI.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [ ] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (except the `## 维护者速读` block the dispatch asks for)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
